limitations: No assertion is made for four or more distinct prime factors.
Existence of any nontrivial solution to the minus-one equation is not established.
Older or poorly indexed literature remains a residual bibliographic risk.
scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically by an exhaustive split on the number of distinct prime-power blocks. The finite checker is regression evidence only and is not used to infer the unbounded statement.
title: A three-support obstruction for the unitary divisor-sum minus-one equation
